page.title: Connect a log storage
page.lead: Your own Grafana or Loki. The address and token stay on this computer in a file only you can read: they never reach the browser or the log.
page.notLocal: Storages are connected from the interface only in local mode. On a server the settings file defines them.
page.loadFailed: The storage list did not load
page.next: Next, create a project and an environment on this storage.

form.title: New storage
form.idHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens. You pick this name in a project environment.
form.lokiUrlHint: Without /loki/api/v1 at the end: Threadline adds the API path itself.
form.tokenHint: In Grafana: Administration → Service accounts, Viewer role.
form.datasourceKind: How the data source is given
form.scopeHint: A project environment on this storage is an equality condition on this label, for example namespace = shop. Usually namespace, service_name or job.
form.checkFirst: Check the connection first. You can save without a check if the storage is unavailable right now.
form.failed: That did not work. Try again or restart Threadline.
form.exists: A storage with this name already exists
form.saveFailed: The storage file was not written: check disk space and permissions on the data folder.

invalid.id: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters, not starting with a hyphen
invalid.grafanaUrl: A Grafana address such as https://grafana.example, without a name, password, parameters or fragment
invalid.lokiUrl: A Loki address such as http://localhost:3100, without /loki/api/v1 at the end and without a name, password, parameters or fragment
invalid.tenant: Latin letters, digits and !._*'()-, up to 150 characters, several tenants separated by |
invalid.auth: Choose how to sign in to Loki
invalid.grafanaToken: A Grafana service account token with the Viewer role: printable characters without spaces
invalid.bearer: A Bearer token: printable characters without spaces
invalid.username: A name up to 256 characters, without a colon
invalid.password: A password up to 1024 characters, without control characters
invalid.datasource: A Loki data source: a name, a uid or a numeric id
invalid.scopeLabel: A label name: Latin letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit

check.unauthorized: The token or password was not accepted: check that it is copied in full and not revoked.
check.forbidden: No access to logs, or the address does not point to the API: Grafana needs the Viewer role, for Loki check the path.
check.not-found: Data source not found: check the name, uid or id of the Loki data source in Grafana.
check.network: No connection: check the address, port and network. The proxy comes from HTTPS_PROXY.
check.certificate: The certificate is not trusted: start Threadline with NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=path-to-root-certificate.
check.other: The storage answered with error “{{code}}”. Details below.
